name.en: Steel carport / solar pergola (S355, rectangular hollow sections)
name.es: Marquesina solar de acero (S355, perfiles huecos rectangulares)

description.en: Freestanding steel carport or pergola carrying modules on rectangular hollow section columns and beams. The reference system uses S355 steel, hot-dip galvanized and powder coated, with stainless A2 fasteners, and a fastening plate embedded in the foundation.
description.es: Marquesina o pérgola de acero autoportante que soporta módulos sobre columnas y vigas de perfil hueco rectangular. El sistema de referencia usa acero S355, galvanizado en caliente y pintado en polvo, con tornillería de acero inoxidable A2 y una placa de fijación embebida en la cimentación.

typical_use: Parking carports and pergolas with solar modules, where the structure is visible and the modules are on a raised, usually horizontal or low-tilt roof.
applicable_standards: ISO 1461 (galvanizing, reference; cited by similar suppliers, not by this datasheet)

materials.finish: Hot-dip galvanized, then powder coated (anthracite RAL 7016, matt)

profiles.name: Profile A, rectangular hollow section 160 x 80 x 5 mm
